what: With the section pinned to the screen while scrolling twice its height (+200%), the circle masking the photo opens from radius 16vmin to 80vmin and covers the screen. The background-colored hole in the circle center (diameter 16vmin) shrinks to 0 within the first 1/3 of progress, so it is a ring at first and soon a solid disc, and the color veil over the photo (screen blend) lifts from .75 to 0. Tied directly to scroll (no curve), so rewinding closes it again. When fully open, is-done

options.pin: If false, it is not attached, it only opens while passing by
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo/video panel to cover (required) — screen height
options.--fx-ring·--fx-hole: Color of the color curtain (default --kf-accent) · hole color (default --kf-bg) — the original has green, blue, yellow and red rings per section

note: The original wrote the same formula twice, vh in landscape and vw in portrait — a single vmin does the same
